newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Six freed after 10 hours in collapsed Lisbon tunnel.
newsitem.headline: Six freed after 10 hours in collapsed Lisbon tunnel.

text.p: Six construction workers were trapped for 10 hours under a concrete slab some 25 metres underground in Lisbon on Wednesday before firefighters managed to bore through to the cavern and free them.

An official from the Lisbon underground train system, which is building the tunnel as part of an extension, said the six were taken to hospital. One suffered a minor injury to his foot but the others were unharmed.
The six survived because they were inside an underground chamber into which air could be pumped. The tunnel collapsed after a landslide triggered by heavy rain.
